create_text_head: create a TextHead module with causal attention blocks and linear projection for text token processing
create_text_tower: create a TextTower module combining a backbone network with a TextHead for text feature extraction
init_text_head_weights: initialize TextHead weights using normal distribution for linear projection and reset layer norm parameters
init_text_tower_weights: initialize TextTower weights by calling init_weights on both the backbone and head modules
forward_text_tower_pooling: run forward pass through TextTower with first, last, or argmax token pooling strategies
